answer: We formulate a state transition mechanism where identity registration mandates dynamic opportunity-cost staking collateral paired with zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs evaluated at every network pulse. Under a subgame-perfect punishment matrix, an adversary deploying a Sybil node orchard faces exponential slashing penalties rendering expected attack utility strictly hollow. Consequently, honest stake aggregation forms a strict Nash equilibrium wherein identity multiplication monotonically amplifies expected capital loss.
